result.task: Locate the Target stores in Atlanta, GA. How many results are shown on the map.
result.final_answer:
I've successfully completed the task. After searching for "Target stores in Atlanta, GA" on Google Maps, I can confirm the following:

## Answer: **7 results** are shown on the map

The search returned 7 Target store locations in the Atlanta, GA area. Each result has a unique entry in the results panel with a corresponding pin/marker on the map:

1. Target - 3660 Marketplace Blvd (4.0 ★, 955 reviews)
2. Target - 100 Perimeter Center Pl (3.9 ★, 1,233 reviews)
3. Target - 375 18th St NW (3.9 ★, 1,075 reviews)
4. Target - 1275 Caroline St NE (3.6 ★, 1,445 reviews)
5. Target - 3535 Peachtree Rd NE (4.0 ★, 528 reviews)
6. Target (south Atlanta location) (4.1 ★, 1,154 reviews)
7. Target (north Atlanta location)

I confirmed this count by running a script that counted all anchors with `aria-label="Target"` in the search results panel, which returned exactly 7 entries, each with their own distinct place URL containing unique coordinates. Google Maps shows a corresponding map marker/pin for each of these 7 stores in the Atlanta metropolitan area.
